title: Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 Confirms Multiple Havens Will Be Revealed With First Story Details
content: Avatar: Seven Havens has revealed the first details of what to expect from Season 2’s new story, and has teased that there will be the reveal of an unexpected new Haven than what has been previously teased thus far.
author: ComicBook

title: After 9 Years, Black Clover Finally Reveals Noelle’s True Feelings for Asta
content: Black Clover has been sitting on this one ever since the TV anime kicked off its run nearly a decade ago, but the newest episode of the second season has finally seen Noelle Silva accept her real feelings of love for Asta.
author: ComicBook

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Earns US$8 Million in 73% Drop at U.S. Box Office, Passes US$100 Million Worldwide
content: In related news, Legendary Entertainment 's new live-action film of CAPCOM 's Street Fighter game series dropped from #11 to #16 in the U.S. box office, earning about US$760,000 last weekend. The film has also earned over US$100 million worldwide.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Most Viral Anime of 2027 Confirms Early Premiere With Major Event
content: There’s been one anime that has already gone viral with fans ahead of its debut with Crunchyroll next year, and it’s now been confirmed that the streaming service will be holding an early premiere for the new series during a major event coming soon.
author: ComicBook

title: LiSA, BABYMETAL Earn Nominations for 2027 Grammy Awards' New Best Asian Pop Music Performance Category
content: Works released between August 31, 2025-August 28, 2026 are eligible for the awards. The awards ceremony will take place on February 7, 2027 at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. It will air and stream on ABC , Disney+ , and Hulu .
author: ANN

title: Yu-Gi-Oh Drops Special Trailer for New Shonen Jump 30th Anniversary Release – Watch
content: Yu-Gi-Oh! is set to release a special version of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine to celebrate its 30th anniversary, and has dropped a special trailer to help celebrate the occasion.

title: New Garfield Revival Animated Series Confirms Release Date With First Look Trailer – Watch
content: Garfield is coming back to screens with a new 2D animated series hitting Paramount+ sooner than you think, and it has now confirmed its release date with its first trailer showing off the new revival in motion.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Officially Confirms When Its Story Will End
content: Avatar: Seven Havens might be currently on the way with Season 2 of the animated series next year, but Paramount+ has already confirmed when the story for the new series is going to end.

title: French Manga, Comic Creator Frédéric Boilet Dies at 66
content: Boilet was born in 1960 at Épinal in Eastern France. He began his comic career with La Nuit des Archées in 1983. He then drew Le rayon vert in 1987 and 36 15 Alexia in 1990. He collaborated with writer Peeters on several works, such as Love Hotel , Tôkyô est mon jardin , and Demi-tour . Boilet moved to Japan in 1993.
author: ANN

title: Big Shonen Jump Hit Confirms It Will End After 6 Years With Next Release
content: One of the biggest hits to come out of the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has now revealed it’s set to end after six years of serialization with its final chapter coming very soon.
author: ComicBook
